dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: To be frank, myself and my admirable colleagues have already... uh...

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: We have completed compiling the data with an efficiency that astonishes even ourselves. And our findings have already been submitted for review.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Our department supervisor was overjoyed to approve, and without even a glance he drew a big circle on the report to indicate he had reviewed it and passed it on up the chain...

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: After all, the approval of something like this cannot be decided by our supervisor alone.
